page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, ensuring no hyperthreading overhead. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system and application data. It also does not feature any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants on the host.

Given the low memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.s3.medium is structured for compute-heavy tasks that do not require large memory footprints. It offers a cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring dedicated CPU execution but minimal RAM. Suitable workloads include lightweight web servers, batch processing, microservices, and basic computational tasks.
